title: Atelier Iris 2: The Azoth of Destiny
synopsis: The second Atelier Iris on PlayStation 2 — a prequel told across two worlds, retained as the NIS America retail disc.

catalog.originalTitle: イリスのアトリエ エターナルマナ2
catalog.mediumForm: Pressed optical disc · PlayStation 2 retail edition

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert
custody.condition: Mint. Purchased factory sealed and opened for custody; disc, printed materials, and packaging show no handling wear. Preserved as a playable reference copy.

curatorNotes:
Atelier Iris 2 reaches back before the first game, following two friends separated between the floating world of Eden and the land below, and lets the player move between their stories. It keeps Eternal Mana’s synthesis at the centre while giving the series a more deliberate structure.

Gust released it in Japan in May 2005 as a direct follow-up to Eternal Mana. NIS America’s North American edition arrived on April 25, 2006, under the subtitle The Azoth of Destiny.

The filing continues the Atelier Iris trilogy between Eternal Mana and Grand Phantasm, under the shared Atelier series authority.
collectionNotes:
Purchased factory sealed and opened for custody while assembling the Gust PlayStation 2 shelf. The copy is mint and complete in box.

The retained object is the standard North American PlayStation 2 edition published by NIS America (SLUS-21327), with manual and cover insert, kept as the reference copy for this filing.

The reference photograph records the seven Gust PlayStation 2 holdings together, as filed in the Collection Hall under synthesis.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation 2; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation 2 consoles. The retained disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: First issued in Japan by Gust on May 26, 2005 as イリスのアトリエ エターナルマナ2. The North American NIS America localization followed on April 25, 2006 (SLUS-21327). European and Australian releases by Koei and THQ later in 2006 are separate editions and are not this filing.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. No current digital edition replaces this North American reference copy.
